notes: Android secret-code support varies by manufacturer, model, firmware, carrier and dialer application.
Generic Android codes are not guaranteed on every Android device.
Manufacturer-specific codes should only be shown when the device family is supported.
Legacy codes are retained for research and compatibility purposes.
Destructive factory-reset codes and security-bypass/FRP/unlock codes are intentionally excluded.
